memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Persistent nasal congestion, sneezing, clear rhinorrhea; skin prick test pending.
  - Plan: Start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS; arrange skin prick test and total IgE; review in 8 weeks.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm) – central adiposity noted.
  - Plan: Diet advice: breakfast – high‑protein, low‑glycemic; lunch – mixed veg with modest carbs; dinner – light, early; avoid late‑night snacks.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05 (baseline check).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Skin prick test: Positive reaction to house dust mite (3+ wheal).
Total serum IgE: 250 IU/mL (Reference <100 IU/mL).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Symptoms markedly improved; occasional mild congestion, no sneezing fits.
  - Plan: Continue current regimen; consider reducing fluticasone to 1 spray each nostril if symptoms stay controlled.
- Weight 67.5 kg, waist 82 cm (still above cutoff).
  - Plan: Diet advice: breakfast – Greek yogurt with berries; lunch – quinoa salad with grilled chicken; dinner – steamed fish & veg; limit refined carbs.
- HbA1c 6.4% (target <7%).
  - Plan: Repeat HbA1c in 3 months.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Cetirizine 10 mg – 1-0-1 (after food)
Fluticasone nasal spray – 2 sprays each nostril OD (after food)
Montelukast 10 mg – 0-0-1 (after food)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑segment changes, no evidence of ischemia or arrhythmia.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had a few nights of mild nasal blockage, but the spray helps. No new symptoms otherwise.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to ENT for evaluation of persistent allergic rhinitis despite medical therapy. Please assess for structural contributors and discuss immunotherapy options.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ENT report: Mild inferior turbinate hypertrophy, no polyps. Recommend continuation of intranasal corticosteroid; consider allergen immunotherapy if symptoms persist. Return to primary care for ongoing management.

- HbA1c 6.6% (stable).

- Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 188 mg/dL, LDL 115, HDL 48, TG 140 (within target).
